parent_objective: synthesize capability-separable source-construction evidence after repeated zero-accepted source results
blocked_by: M1256 stops same event-timing variants and routes to branch synthesis
supersedes: another local capability-separable source-construction run without synthesis

public_gates: M1257 must preserve actor input contract
M1257 must not use private holdout
M1257 must summarize M1241-M1256 source-construction evidence
M1257 must choose continue, pivot, stop, or promote_to_next_branch
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, proposal labels, timing labels, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not start another source run before synthesis

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes M1241-M1256 source-construction evidence and chooses the next source branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop current local source-construction branch if repeated zero-accepted results indicate a source-family gap
stop if next proposal is just another budget/window/relocation tweak without a new evidence variable
fallback_plan: if synthesis finds a concrete missing source variable, pre-register one bounded source branch
if synthesis finds source-family exhaustion, pivot to broader source family, richer hidden-fault model, or teacher/optimizer-derived source
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1241-M1256 exceeds the branch synthesis cadence and M1256 stops same timing variants

admission_evidence: M1242-M1255 repeatedly produced zero accepted source rows
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next-branch manifest if synthesis admits it
next_stage_criteria: synthesis chooses continue, pivot, stop, or promote_to_next_branch
next branch has a new evidence variable if any run is admitted

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1257 synthesizes offline source-construction evidence and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist or synthesis changes the source strategy
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Aggregate zero-accepted source-construction results into branch-level evidence instead of treating a single run as decisive.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The repeated zero-accepted capability-separable source results now require a branch-level synthesis before any further source construction.
success_criteria: synthesis records supported and falsified claims
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: synthesis admits another local source run without a new evidence variable
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1257 passes if it writes a synthesis answering all required questions and chooses a next branch without training or threshold relaxation.
